correctness.rationale: Long–Narayanan Theorem 1.1 establishes eventual periods 1 or 2 for the specified synchronous integer diffusion rule, so any initially periodic class obeys F²(x)=x. Conservation of total mass removes spurious translation shifts. The edge reversal energy identity gives an iff criterion. Direct case analysis of each triangle yields (0,0),(1,-1),(-1,1) at D=0; at D>0, either zero-coordinate D=1 or positive diagonal/consecutive pairs, with 3D-2 choices. Global sum for r>=2 excludes D=1 and forces D=2r; sign reflection gives -2r. Nonconstant periodic pairs are genuine two-cycles. Independent direct complete r=2 enumeration over [-4,4]^4 gave 100,9,100 states, 209 total; finite test corroborates rather than proves all-r classification.
